description: Shared gte-modernbert encoder with two sigmoid heads (toxic, jailbreak), full fine-tune on the whole pool (4,862) with soft labels = mean of deepseek-v4.1-flash + qwen3.7-flash (per-example, guidance v2 + 20 seeds) [+ claude-haiku-5.5 batched for config B], plus LLM-synthetic positives/hard negatives steered by pool prompts and relabeled by the ensemble; uniform weight soup of 7 fine-tunes (3 seeds config A, 4 seeds config B); ONNX int8 with mlp/Wo kept fp32. Thresholds chosen on dev (bootstrap + window-smoothed F1 argmax) on the int8 model's dev probabilities. Chosen over soupA/soupB (tied on dev) for averaging the most seeds.
